name: The Final Oracle
description: The ultimate test. The Final Oracle mirrors your board and reveals your past in Phase 3.

actions.description: Copies your primary synergy as a resistance
Reveals as your best run's ghost board
All your synergies now provide resistance
Mirrors player's strongest synergy as resistance
Reveals as the ghost of player's best run

weakness_description: The Final Oracle has no obvious weakness - you must outplay its mirror abilities
